title: Qualify portable retained arithmetic on required software Vulkan runtimes
body:
Complete retained Vulkan runtime, scientific/provider qualification and release admission remain open. Source/build and finite controls do not establish the supported runtime estate.

Current source is clean, committed and pushed at [4bcd987](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/4bcd9875cd9308deabed06a5fa2f17d2321b0cbc) on `development/retained-dense-step-control-2026-10-06`, the head of [draft PR #62](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/pull/62). Main remains `5e706073a3fd2f9afcf8efbcde2f094122050f6a`. [Fresh PR merge-tree integration CI 38336123427](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38336123427) passes the three Linux/Windows/macOS build and non-render integration jobs; all four full qualification jobs are skipped. Its checkout is merge commit `2c934151484e7df886221eb343ebbdef97e68294`, whose tree equals 4bcd987. This supports source integration, not exact-revision native qualification.

Verified current Windows/macOS native build-only exports from [manual exact-revision CI 38318828623](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38318828623) and the synchronized primary GCC qualification receipt admit `macos-native-build` and `windows-native-build`: **2/8 external domains**. The six pending domains are:

- `macos-moltenvk`
- `physical-imax-5616x4096`
- `physical-radeon-780m`
- `viewer-native-window-input`
- `windows-native-vulkan`
- `wsl2-dozen`

The current GCC build binds all seven executables, nine product artifacts and twenty qualification inputs to 4bcd987 and that receipt. The complete Mandatory receipt is absent; readiness, release readiness and evidence-generation readiness remain false. Local Clang has its separate 0/8 configuration. [Current synchronization and admission evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/48#issuecomment-6136782966). Raw current exports remain under `attestations/native-build/4bcd987`; GCC synchronization evidence remains under `attestations/alignment/4bcd987/gcc-revision-synchronisation`. Earlier native/software evidence retains its own source and execution bounds.

Affected source includes the retained arithmetic/shaders and builder, compute/integrator/executor/renderer consumers, `tests/operating_model.json`, and the existing attestation, alignment, build-gate and installed-readiness authorities. Preserve one source/model authority, canonical input bytes, exact compiled-array/consumer joins, live test registration and actual device/stream identity. Accepted finite repairs and rejected cost experiments remain in #44 and the linked issue history; their scoped evidence is not a full runtime qualification.

Required acceptance:

1. Preserve every supported physical state, all 40 coupled fields, four film/pupil columns, seven RHS records, three independent RK trials and four quartics. Keep rounding/enclosures, precision admission, refusal/recovery, projected/dense/interior/event/source/volume checks, whole-state rollback, layouts/governors and the original independent references, tolerances, budgets, counts and scenes.
2. Resolve the original required software frame inside 300 seconds and [#44's usable physical rendering](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/44), preserving the accepted #39 bounds and broader capability scope.
3. Obtain fresh complete zero-failure/error/skip Mandatory execution binding live registration, strict products, every executable, alignment/model/source and consumed resources. Registration inventories are not executions.
4. Complete the applicable scientific/provider/runtime estate and all eight model-derived external domains on the same exact clean revision. Include usable Radeon 780M preview under 2048 MiB, native-window/input evidence, and the original disk-free beam-filtered 100000-star moving-ThinLens scenes at 1920×1080 and 5616×4096. Build records claim no runtime; provider/physical records must meet their own existing contracts.
5. Complete [#53's final CPU scientific integration](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53), admit every required domain through release alignment, and complete the required fresh estate and installed-product/readiness checks on exact clean pushed main.

Dependency order: resolve rendering and final CPU integration, then complete same-revision Mandatory and the applicable runtime/platform/viewer/image/scientific domains, followed by final-main release admission. Partial qualification may admit the two build domains while leaving readiness false; it does not complete release acceptance. No weakened gates or unchanged rejected experiment retries. Preserve useful source/findings in pushed Git and issues, keep ignored raw evidence local, and remove superseded scratch/refs only after preservation and ownership checks.
